purpose: Run the 3-6 V DC motor/fan only while the momentary button is held.
behavior: Arduino INPUT_PULLUP reads D2 LOW, drives D8 HIGH, and energizes a bare 5 V relay.
assumptions: The relay is the kit's bare 5-pin SPDT relay, not a relay module.
A regulated 5 V supply rated at least 1 A powers the motor side.
Only low-voltage DC is used; the relay's NC contact is unused.

verification_checks.pass_condition: USB and external 5 V motor supply are disconnected.
Unpowered meter finds about 70 ohm across the coil and continuity only between COM and NC.
No continuity exists directly between either 5 V rail and its return.
D8 reaches base only through 1 kOhm; emitter reaches GND; collector reaches coil.
Both diode stripes face the positive side of their inductive load.
Unpowered continuity changes only while the button is held.
Relay clicks and fan runs only while the button is held.

safety_invariants: Never connect the relay coil or motor directly to an Arduino GPIO pin.
Disconnect every power source before moving wires or using continuity mode.
Keep the fan blade clear and confirm relay pins with an unpowered continuity test.
